Admin._comment: Shared secret for the /dashboard order manager. Never sent as a header directly — the browser exchanges it once via POST /api/admin/auth/challenge then /login (HMAC challenge-response) for a short-lived X-Admin-Session token. Blank disables every admin endpoint.
Admin._backupPasscodeComment: Second, separate secret required only for /dashboard/backup.html (export/restore the whole database), exchanged the same way via POST /api/admin/backup/auth/challenge then /login for a short-lived X-Backup-Session token. Set via Admin__BackupPasscode env var. Blank disables backup/restore entirely — keep it different from ApiKey and hold it more tightly.
Admin._dashboardPasscodeComment: Optional passcode for the dashboard's idle-lock screen (index.html/backup.html re-lock 60s after the last interaction). Set via Admin__DashboardPasscode env var. Blank simply leaves the lock screen off — unlike ApiKey/BackupPasscode this doesn't gate an API action, so there's nothing that needs to fail closed if it's unset.

RequestSigning._comment: Shared secret embedded in the Android client, matched against X-Request-Signature on every /api/** call except /api/admin/**. Blank leaves this UNENFORCED — only set it once the client build carrying the matching secret is what's actually installed, or every existing install gets locked out immediately.

DeviceRestore._comment: Shows the Device Restore tab on the admin dashboard and enables POST /api/admin/devices/restore. Prefer enabling temporarily with DeviceRestore__Enabled=true only while recovering an account.

Telegram._comment: Optional API, Instagram call, and crash logging. Set real values only through Render env vars: Telegram__Enabled=true, Telegram__BotToken, Telegram__ChatId.

Payments._comment: UPI payee shown when a user buys a plan. Set via Payments__UpiId / Payments__PayeeName. Blank UpiId disables plan purchases.

SmmPanel._comment: External SMM panel integration. Set ApiKey via SmmPanel__ApiKey env var. PollIntervalMinutes controls background sync frequency.
